Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner agent incorrectly extracted the birth year for B. S. Ranga as 1897 in its analysis of Step 9, despite the WebSurfer's search results clearly stating the director was born on November 11, 1917. This data extraction error led to a false comparison where the agent concluded B. S. Ranga (1897) was born earlier than George Cukor (1899), whereas the correct comparison (1917 vs 1899) shows George Cukor was born earlier. The error stems from a failure to accurately read and transcribe the verified data from the previous step.
